lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is Wednesday's Board of County Commissioners meeting, where the San Miguel County Housing Authority will vote to shift Pinion Park's income eligibility to 80% AMI — a quiet policy change that determines who actually gets a deed-restricted unit in this valley. Also Tuesday, Town Council opens a full day of work sessions covering the Comprehensive Plan, a Gondola Subcommittee update, and a third-party audit of rental housing policy, while the Housing Authority Subcommittee takes up the Martin exception request — a real roof, a real cost, a real precedent. On the community side, the Youth Area grand opening at Wilkinson Public Library happens Wednesday, and the Stories in the Sky drone show lands Thursday.

notable.stake: Third-party rental housing audit review touches who can afford to stay here.
Martin exception vote sets precedent for deed-restricted unit repair costs.
